The treatment was completely exercise-based, focused on strengthening, stretching, and posture correction.

✅ My left leg is completely fine now
✅ I can bend comfortably
✅ Lower-back pain reduced a lot
✅ Leg & back muscles feel stronger
✅ I can sit for 12+ hours without discomfort
✅ No more painkillers

I am really, really grateful because her dedication helped me get back to normal and work properly again.

She is always smiling, calm and very positive. She keeps telling patients,
“Don’t worry, everything will be fine,”
and that gives huge confidence.

Every session starts with her asking about pain or changes since the last visit, and she adjusts treatment accordingly. She even tells patients that they can message her anytime if there is any pain and she will guide them — her dedication is truly admirable.

This centre is especially helpful for working professionals who sit for long hours. Her personal attention, positive attitude, and genuine care make a huge difference.

I truly admire her and highly recommend The Physiotherapy Centre — Dr. Dhwani Modi.
A big thank you, doctor! 🙏
